notes.title: Steam Shmup Fest and Small Update
notes.content:
Hello all,

It has been a little over a year since the release of Vector Assault 2.  Starting today is the Steam Shmup Fest so with that I have released an update.
[list]
[*] 
[*] Fixed some missing text errors that had been placed.
[*] Fixed some translation errors for power ups.
[*] Fixed a bug where in the Zones game mode enemies would spawn inside of active zones.
[*] Fixed a bug that mad the player ship shield not display correctly
[*] Added 3 new ships each with their own weapons and sub weapons.
[/list]

For those of you who don't have the game their is a sale during the week of the Steam Shmup Fest.

If you are wanting to try the game I have also released a demo version that you can download to give the game a try.

Thanks
WizByte Games.

notes.title: Vector Assault 2 version 1.0.4 is now out
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where resolution is not set correctly for first time startup
Fix an issue where using mouse and keyboard wasn't functioning properly
Fixed missing localization text

notes.title: Vector Assault 2 Patch 1.0.3 now live
notes.content:
[list]
[*] - Fixed a bug where when you load the game the Achievements UI was scaled incorrectly
[*] - Fixed a bug where Achievements didn't display their Achievement Icons.
[*] - Fixed a bug where if you played in the closed beta and didn't delete your save data the game would soft lock when selecting a game mode
[*] - Fixed a bug where the mouse cursor would be displayed when on the controls screen even when using a controller
[*] - Fixed a bug where when selecting an option on the options screen new changes were not being reflected correctly
[*] - Fixed a bug where the screen resolution was not being displayed correctly when launching the game.
[*] - Fixed a bug where when using the Sweeper Drone collision detection wasn't being triggered.
[*] - Added a second projectile for non upgraded firing for Ship 1 for gameplay balance
[*] - Added unlock info on the game mode select screen so there is an indication on how to unlock locked game modes.
[*] - Added 30 seconds to some Boss Fights for gameplay balance
[/list]

Possible Bugs
[list]
[*] - When in the Settings screen some controllers will rapidly cycle through options making it impossible to select an option.  Still investigating the cause.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch version 1.0.1
notes.content: For those of you who played the game Yesterday you might have noticed you weren't getting achievements.  I'm sorry for that there was some code in the game blocking the Achievements from being registered.  I think I have fixed it.  Also the in game achievements screen wasn't displaying correctly so that has also be fixed.

notes.title: Release Date is Here
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

Vector Assault 2 has now been released, and you can purchase it for $4.99 USD.  It has been a long 18 months of development and I hope everyone that plays the game enjoys it.  For the next few weeks I will be monitoring the Steam community forums, and my Twitter to see if anyone has any questions or issues with the game.  Hopefully there will be no issues.  Feedback on the game is totally welcome and it would be appreciated.

In the current build of the game we have the following

[list]
[*] - 4 playable ships each with unique primary and sub weapons
[*] - 11 arenas
[*] - 8 power-ups that can be upgraded.
[*] - 5 main game modes
[*] - Challenge levels across the 5 game modes plus some additional modes exclusive to the challenge modes.
[/list]

Vector Assault 2 is a vastly improvement on the original and hopefully it will be enjoyed by all that play it.

notes.title: Vector Assault 2 Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
Vector Assault 2 is finally in the final stage of development and will be released on 9/1/22.  It has been almost 118 months since the start of Vector Assault 2's development.  The game was going to be just an update to Vector Assault, but I lost the source code for the project a few years ago, and trying to do an add on for the game was impossible and rebuilding the game turned into adding new features and modifying the game so much that it was decided that it should be a sequel instead.

If you are interested in Vector Assault 2 the game will release on 9/1/22, and I hope everyone that plays it will enjoy playing it as much as I did developing it.

notes.title: Beta Feedback Wanted
notes.content:
For those of you who signed up for the Closed Beta test for Vector Assault 2 it is now downloadable.  If you missed the sign up period don't worry about it.  There may be another playtest in the future if more testing and feedback is needed.

For those of you who are in the closed beta please feel free to give feedback on the Steam community forums for Vector Assault 2 or join the  [url=https://discord.gg/abD7JzW2]WizByte Games Discord Server[/url]

notes.title: Vector Assault 2 Closed Beta Sign Up
notes.content:
Hello,

I have been working on Vector Assault 2 for a while and I have gotten to the point where I would like people to play the game, and help test it to make it the best possible game.  And since Steam has the playtest feature it is easier to get feedback and make the game better than the original Vector Assault in every way.

If you are interested in helping test the game you can do so by going to the game page for Vector Assault 2 and signing up for the beta.  Sign ups will be for one week and then the beta will start.  Once the beta has started it will be for one week.  this gives people time to test the game and give as much feed back as possible.

If you are interested in learning more about the game or giving feedback you can also join the WizByte Games Discord Server https://discord.gg/Sa6DFutvxH
